description: This is a PHP source code file defining the Marketplace controller class within the Opencart admin module. It handles various admin actions related to marketplace integrations, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and API interactions for extensions and promotions.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extensions, aggregating data about extensions, promotions, and categories, as well as handling API interactions for marketplace data fetching.

classes.name: extension
classes.description: Handles functionalities related to marketplace extensions, including listing, purchasing, downloading, installing, uninstalling, and deleting extensions within the OpenCart admin environment.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads language, sets the page title, processes request filtering parameters, constructs URLs with filters, makes an API call to fetch marketplace extensions and promotions, and prepares data for rendering the view.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Main method that handles the display and processing of extension information, including validation, filtering, and rendering the marketplace extension view.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Handles the purchase process for extensions, including permission checks, API communication for creating purchase requests, and response handling.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Manages the download of extension packages, including authentication, API requests, and updating session data about downloads.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to an extension, involving API call with data hashing and signature generation, and processes API response to confirm success or show error.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Retrieves comments for a specific extension, supports pagination, and fetches comments and replies via API calls, then prepares data for the view.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Retrieves replies to a specific comment, supports pagination and API communication, and formats reply data for rendering.
